en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5647 - Al-Bazanti narrated from Al-Muthanna from Al-Hasan Al-Ṣayqal from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:

I asked Imam (as) about a paternal nephew and a grandfather (regarding inheritance).
Imam (as) said: "The inheritance is divided equally between them, half and half."
